goal: Prevent wallet database corruption and recover automatically if errors happen during legacy migration
Isolate legacy wallet code so active descriptor wallet work is simpler and safer
reviewability: Review logic now because conflicts with master are mechanical
agreement: No objections or concerns raised so far

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it protects user funds from corruption caused by stale SQLite journal files during migration
Automatic rollback on failure prevents leaving users with broken, partially migrated wallets
Maintainers benefit from isolated legacy code that can no longer complicate new wallet features
